title: achnatherum inebrians
intro: Achnatherum inebrians, commonly known as "Winecup Grass" or "Drunkman's Preventative", is a type of flowering plant in the grass family. This plant is traditionally used to treat hangovers and intoxication, hence its common name. The health benefits of Achnatherum inebrians include its ability to calm the stomach, reduce nausea, and alleviate symptoms of intoxication. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that are believed to contribute to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and sedative effects.
